entities.name: Nazahn
entities.description: A legendary nacatl artificer of Naya on Alara, once an ordinary blacksmith, now a renowned weaponsmith on Bant who wields a magical hammer.

entities.name: Conflux
entities.description: The event that merged Nazahn's home with the shard of Bant.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: A shard of Alara where Nazahn found fame.

events.summary: The Conflux merges Nazahn's home with the shard of Bant, and he becomes a renowned weaponsmith for Bant's knightly orders.
events.quote: his life changed when the Conflux merged his home with the shard of Bant
